messages:
anya: hey folks — quick ping: i opened a small PR to replace the curl quickstart with a streaming example that uses chunked responses. wanted a sanity check before i merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482

luca: thanks! will take a look in a few. is this just a copy tweak or does it change the example behavior?

anya: mostly example behavior — i changed the curl flags to use `--no-buffer` and added `Accept: text/event-stream` sample, and added a note about newline handling on mac/linux. also added a 1-line note about auth header example with env var.

matt: quick glance — the `--no-buffer` thing is good but we should show `-N` for compatibility (some curl builds use that). also might mention that older mac curl needs `--http1.1` for SSE. small nit: auth example uses `-H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\"` but we usually prefer `-H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" \` on multi-line examples so folks can paste.

anya: thanks, i can add both `-N` and `--no-buffer` + short comment about `--http1.1`. will update the PR shortly.

sam: I'll sanity-check the wording for the auth note later today. also can we add a tiny snippet showing how to pipe output to `jq -R -r .` to parse event-stream lines? saves users time.

anya: good call — i'll add a one-liner. new snippet:```bash
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/stream?model=redwood-1" | jq -R -r 'select(length>0)'
```

matt: looks good. leaving a couple inline comments on the PR for phrasing. :thumbsup:

devrel-bot: github: PR #482 — anya/quickstart-curl-streaming — updated 2 files — reviewers requested: @luca, @sam

luca: got the ping, will review now. if no major comments i'll approve and you can merge after sam's wording pass.

anya: awesome, thanks everyone — i'll wait for approvals before merging. :rocket:
